99.8595% water - you got me this time - I normally check ingredients because I'm a chemist by education and trade. That said, I blow it sometimes and did so with this as well because I was in a hurry and I ordered it late at night. I could kick myself. According to the label, this is 99.96% water, or 0.14% active ingredient. Now understand that the essentially same active ingredients that are used in swimming pool algaecide, but those are sold at 40-60% active ingredients, making that up to 428 times stronger than this product.

In case you're not good at math, if you buy a quart of 60% pool liquid algaecide that has the words "ammonium chloride" in the name of the active ingredients, you can literally put a half teaspoon of that algaecide in a quart of water and you'll still have something slightly stronger than this garbage. That makes this product roughly 200 times more expensive per quart and means you are buying very little other than a plastic bottle to put in a landfill.

Please, only buy this if you're lazy and can't measure out a half teaspoon of something.

My First UV Curing Lamp And It Is Great! - I am very impressed with this UV gel nail dryer. I do acrylic to my own nails and just got into gel polish. I purchased a top coat and base coat and then some color changing gel polish. This UV gel dryer is a great size and fits my whole hand inside. It comes with two settings: low and high, as you just press the button in the direction of which you prefer. The off button is in the center. The red button is the 120 second (2 minute) timer. You turn your device on and to whatever setting and press that button and it will turn the device off when done.

I applied a thin layer of base coat to my nail and let it cure for 2 minutes. Then I applied a thin layer of gel polish and let it cure for 2 minutes. I repeated the same step until I got the desired opacity. Afterwards, I touched it softly to see if the polish was dry and noticed it was very slightly still not dry (a light print of my fingerprint) so I put the top coat on and cured for about 5 minutes. It was completely dry by then, as I used thin coats and cured between so that it wasn't completely wet on bottom and dry just on top and smudge. I am very happy with this curing lamp, as it is my first. It is great quality plastic and the bottom of the inside of the lamp slides in/out for your convenience. It also comes with a US plug so no adapters needed. Just plug and play!
